item.title: In The Money podcast with Jack Schwager
item.description: 8 years back, I spoke to Jack Schwager, the man behind the Market Wizards series. Sandeep Rao spoke to him again recently on In The Money, and it was an interesting conversation. Market Wizards is probably the only book I’ve read multiple times when I was trading actively. The one thing that stood out to me from the video was the debate between systematic vs. discretionary trading. There’s a common assumption that the best traders are rules-based, meaning they follow a fixed set of rules.
